description: Read-only for TaskLite: reads the call log from the customer's PBX for a range and shows what a sync would write, without writing anything or moving the sync position. Returns counts (fetched, already on the board) and the last 20 calls as board rows (title, cells by column id, the customer and employee matched). Works before a mapping exists (then rows come back unmapped), so use it to look at the real calls first. from and to are local days (YYYY-MM-DD), up to 31 days back; omit both for the same window a scheduled sync would read. Owner or admin of the app.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: preview_telephony_sync
